glen: Heads-up  I set a vendor choreography call for tomorrow 9am PT to finalize wave releases for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi. We need to pin embargo windows and a contingency lane for H200 slips.

teri: I'll own press choreography + partner opt-in. Need vendor legal embargo constraints by EOD. Prefer no public announce on Fridays.

amanda: Marketplace ops here  we can publish hidden SKUs for SI but require `signed_driver_checksum` and a `canary_ok` tag before anything is consumed by customers. Who provides the checksum?

viktor: Infra will produce signed checksums when CI finishes packaging. Expect nightly canaries; GA driver ETA from vendors is a range, not a date. We'll surface CI badges in the listing.

glen: Thinking a two-wave plan to reduce collision risk: Wave 1: SI previews + hidden listing (H100 + Gaudi). Wave 2: Published marketplace + docs (MI300, B200). Wave 3: Press/blog (H200) with 72h quote review.

amanda: Sounds good. Add gating fields in SKU metadata: `prelist_visibility`, `signed_driver_checksum`, `driver_signoff`, `quote_review_complete`. We'll flip `prelist_visibility` from hidden->public when all true.

teri: Vendors asked for a 48h quote review, marketing prefers 72h. Let's standardize to 72h and note exceptions. Also request partner logo assets by Tue end-of-day.

viktor: Routing fallback proposal for ops: `primary: H200; fallback: [H100,B200]; grace_period_days: 14`. We'll test auto-route logic in staging.

glen: SI capacity note: Gaudi racks limited Apr 2-8. Viktor, can infra tag two daily lab windows for SI teams?

viktor: Yes, reserving Apr 3 & Apr 6 for extended SI runs. I'll post a signup sheet.

amanda: Marketplace will also add pricing metadata for Dedicated offers (min_commit_days: 30) and quota defaults. Need final SKU IDs tonight.

glen: Action list:
- Viktor: publish canary artifacts + signed checksums, reserve Gaudi slots
- Amanda: add SKU gating fields + prelist workflow, add pricing metadata
- Teri: embargo copy + partner opt-in doc; collect vendor legal windows

partner-bot: Calendar invite created: "HW wave release dry-run" Tomorrow 09:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood.com/event/5932101111-wave-dryrun :white_check_mark:

glen: One more: if H200 slips beyond fallback window, we should push a joint statement offering SI assistance and prioritized driver fixes. Please flag legal and partner success to draft that.

amanda: Will add `fallback_public_statement` to the runbook and loop in sales/partner-success.

teri: I'll circulate the embargo doc in the invite and request vendor confirmation on logo usage + quote approvals.

glen: Thanks all  ping this thread with any slips or vendor late notes. :rocket:
